/**
 * What every EveryParent does, and every Actor type that inherits from it.
 */
abstract class EveryParentBase(
    final override val body: BoxBody,
    color: Color,
    score: Float,
    title: String,
    isShielded: Boolean,
    final override val collisionMask: CollisionMask,
) : Batched, Dynamic, CollisionDetector, KeyboardInputAware {
    @set:Exposed(name = "color")
    var color: Color = color

    /**
     * How opaque the Actor is drawn, from 0 to 1, on top of its color's own opacity; set by the opacity Blocks.
     */
    var opacity = 1f

    /**
     * In scene units per second: the Actor moves by this much every second.
     */
    var velocity = SceneOffset.Zero

    override val isAlwaysActive = true

    /**
     * Set by the Blocks that remove this Actor, which Kubriko does after the frame: until then, it is skipped.
     */
    var isRemoved = false

    @set:Exposed(name = "score")
    var score: Float = score

    @set:Exposed(name = "title")
    var title: String = title

    @set:Exposed(name = "isShielded")
    var isShielded: Boolean = isShielded

    /**
     * The middle of the Actor in the Scene, wherever its pivot is, which is where its collision mask goes.
     */
    private val bodyCenter get() = body.axisAlignedBoundingBox.let { (it.min + it.max) / 2 }
    override val collidableTypes: List<KClass<out Collidable>> = listOf(EveryBlock::class, EveryParentBase::class)
    protected lateinit var actorManager: ActorManager
    protected lateinit var viewportManager: ViewportManager
    protected lateinit var keyboardInputManager: KeyboardInputManager
    protected lateinit var stateManager: StateManager
    protected lateinit var generatedScenes: GeneratedScenes
    protected lateinit var generatedAudio: GeneratedAudio
    protected lateinit var spriteManager: SpriteManager
    protected lateinit var everyManagerManager: EveryManager

    /**
     * Until spawnEnemy finishes, or 0 while it doesn't run, and how often it finishes again, or 0 if it doesn't.
     */
    protected var spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 0L
    protected var spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0L

    /**
     * Until timer1 finishes, or 0 while it doesn't run, and how often it finishes again, or 0 if it doesn't.
     */
    protected var timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 0L
    protected var timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0L

    /**
     * Until timer2 finishes, or 0 while it doesn't run, and how often it finishes again, or 0 if it doesn't.
     */
    protected var timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0L
    protected var timer2PeriodInMilliseconds = 0L

    /**
     * Whether it is pushed back whenever it reaches past an edge of the Scene.
     */
    protected open val staysInsideScene = false

    /**
     * The edges it reached past on the last frame, every one before the first, so the edge Event runs only when it starts
     * reaching past one, never for where it was added.
     */
    private var wasTouchingLeftEdge = true
    private var wasTouchingRightEdge = true
    private var wasTouchingTopEdge = true
    private var wasTouchingBottomEdge = true

    /**
     * Whether it has been at least partly inside the Scene since it last left it.
     */
    private var wasInsideScene = false

    /**
     * How fast its sprite's frames play: 1 for their own pace, 0 to stop, and below 0 backwards.
     */
    var animationSpeed = 1f

    /**
     * Whether its sprite's frames start over after the last one.
     */
    var isAnimationLooping = true

    /**
     * Shows [frame] of its sprite, when it is cut into frames.
     */
    protected open fun setFrame(frame: Int) = Unit

    /**
     * Plays its sprite's frames for [deltaTimeInMilliseconds], when it is cut into frames.
     */
    protected open fun stepAnimation(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) = Unit

    override fun onAdded(kubriko: Kubriko) {
        actorManager = kubriko.get()
        viewportManager = kubriko.get()
        keyboardInputManager = kubriko.get()
        stateManager = kubriko.get()
        generatedScenes = kubriko.get()
        generatedAudio = kubriko.get()
        spriteManager = kubriko.get()
        everyManagerManager = kubriko.get()
        onAddedToScene(kubriko)
    }

    override fun update(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) {
        if (isRemoved) return
        stepAnimation(deltaTimeInMilliseconds)
        if (spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds > 0) {
            spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds -= deltaTimeInMilliseconds
            if (spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds <= 0) {
                spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = if (spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds > 0) (spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds + spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds).coerceAtLeast(1) else 0
                onSpawnEnemyFinished(deltaTimeInMilliseconds)
            }
        }
        if (timer1RemainingInMilliseconds > 0) {
            timer1RemainingInMilliseconds -= deltaTimeInMilliseconds
            if (timer1RemainingInMilliseconds <= 0) {
                timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = if (timer1PeriodInMilliseconds > 0) (timer1RemainingInMilliseconds + timer1PeriodInMilliseconds).coerceAtLeast(1) else 0
                onTimer1Finished(deltaTimeInMilliseconds)
            }
        }
        if (timer2RemainingInMilliseconds > 0) {
            timer2RemainingInMilliseconds -= deltaTimeInMilliseconds
            if (timer2RemainingInMilliseconds <= 0) {
                timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = if (timer2PeriodInMilliseconds > 0) (timer2RemainingInMilliseconds + timer2PeriodInMilliseconds).coerceAtLeast(1) else 0
            }
        }
        onEveryFrame(deltaTimeInMilliseconds)
        body.position += velocity * (deltaTimeInMilliseconds.coerceAtMost(33) / 1000f)
        val box = body.axisAlignedBoundingBox
        val sceneSettings = generatedScenes.settings
        val leftEdge = if (sceneSettings == null) viewportManager.topLeft.value.x else sceneSettings.topLeft.x
        val rightEdge = if (sceneSettings == null) viewportManager.bottomRight.value.x else sceneSettings.bottomRight.x
        val topEdge = if (sceneSettings == null) viewportManager.topLeft.value.y else sceneSettings.topLeft.y
        val bottomEdge = if (sceneSettings == null) viewportManager.bottomRight.value.y else sceneSettings.bottomRight.y
        val isTouchingLeftEdge = box.min.x < leftEdge
        val isTouchingRightEdge = box.max.x > rightEdge
        val isTouchingTopEdge = box.min.y < topEdge
        val isTouchingBottomEdge = box.max.y > bottomEdge
        val isInsideScene = staysInsideScene || (box.max.x > leftEdge && box.min.x < rightEdge && box.max.y > topEdge && box.min.y < bottomEdge)
        if (staysInsideScene && (isTouchingLeftEdge || isTouchingRightEdge || isTouchingTopEdge || isTouchingBottomEdge)) {
            body.position += SceneOffset(
                if (isTouchingLeftEdge) leftEdge - box.min.x else if (isTouchingRightEdge) rightEdge - box.max.x else SceneUnit.Zero,
                if (isTouchingTopEdge) topEdge - box.min.y else if (isTouchingBottomEdge) bottomEdge - box.max.y else SceneUnit.Zero,
            )
        }
        if ((staysInsideScene && (isTouchingLeftEdge || isTouchingRightEdge || isTouchingTopEdge || isTouchingBottomEdge)) || (isTouchingLeftEdge && !wasTouchingLeftEdge) || (isTouchingRightEdge && !wasTouchingRightEdge) || (isTouchingTopEdge && !wasTouchingTopEdge) || (isTouchingBottomEdge && !wasTouchingBottomEdge)) onEdgeTouched(deltaTimeInMilliseconds, isTouchingLeftEdge, isTouchingRightEdge, isTouchingTopEdge, isTouchingBottomEdge)
        wasTouchingLeftEdge = isTouchingLeftEdge && !staysInsideScene
        wasTouchingRightEdge = isTouchingRightEdge && !staysInsideScene
        wasTouchingTopEdge = isTouchingTopEdge && !staysInsideScene
        wasTouchingBottomEdge = isTouchingBottomEdge && !staysInsideScene
        if (isInsideScene) {
            wasInsideScene = true
        } else if (wasInsideScene) {
            wasInsideScene = false
            if (!isRemoved) onLeftScene(deltaTimeInMilliseconds)
        }
        collisionMask.position = bodyCenter
        when (val mask = collisionMask) {
            is CircleCollisionMask -> mask.radius = body.size.width * body.scale.horizontal / 2
            is BoxCollisionMask -> mask.rotation = body.rotation
            else -> Unit
        }
    }

    override fun onCollisionDetected(collidables: List<Collidable>) {
        if (isRemoved) return
        for (index in collidables.indices) {
            when (val other = collidables[index]) {
                is EveryBlock -> if (!other.isRemoved) onCollisionWithEveryBlock(other)
                is EveryParentBase -> if (!other.isRemoved) onCollisionWithEveryParent(other)
            }
        }
    }

    protected open fun onAddedToScene(kubriko: Kubriko) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val speed = 200f
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * speed
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                                                        println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }
                                                    if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(-45f, 120f)
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 360f + 0f), (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 200f + 100f))
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(score, everyManagerManager.score)
                                                    color = Color(0xFFE05050).copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    color = when (KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(3)) { 0 -> Color(0xFF20C060); 1 -> Color(0xFFFFFFFF); else -> Color(0xFF000000) }.copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    opacity = (0f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 60f + 20f) / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + -10f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + everyManagerManager.score / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    protected open fun onEdgeTouched(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int, isTouchingLeftEdge: Boolean, isTouchingRightEdge: Boolean, isTouchingTopEdge: Boolean, isTouchingBottomEdge: Boolean) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        if (isTouchingLeftEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit, velocity.y)
        if (isTouchingRightEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(-velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit, velocity.y)
        if (isTouchingTopEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x, velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit)
        if (isTouchingBottomEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x, -velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit)
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())

        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.

            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared

                    }
                }
            }
        }

    protected open fun onLeftScene(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) {

        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)

        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val speed = 200f
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * speed
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                                                        println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }
                                                    if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(-45f, 120f)
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 360f + 0f), (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 200f + 100f))
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(score, everyManagerManager.score)
                                                    color = Color(0xFFE05050).copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    color = when (KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(3)) { 0 -> Color(0xFF20C060); 1 -> Color(0xFFFFFFFF); else -> Color(0xFF000000) }.copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    opacity = (0f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 60f + 20f) / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + -10f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + everyManagerManager.score / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    protected open fun onKeyPressedDirectionLeft() {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val speed = 200f
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE

                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }
                                                    if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(-45f, 120f)
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 360f + 0f), (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 200f + 100f))
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(score, everyManagerManager.score)
                                                    color = Color(0xFFE05050).copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    color = when (KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(3)) { 0 -> Color(0xFF20C060); 1 -> Color(0xFFFFFFFF); else -> Color(0xFF000000) }.copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    opacity = (0f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 60f + 20f) / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + -10f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + everyManagerManager.score / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    protected open fun onKeyPressedDirectionDown() {
        if (keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.DirectionDown)) {
            if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Held".let { logged ->
                Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
            }
        }
    }

                Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))

            if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Held".let { logged ->
                Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
            }
        }
    }

    protected open fun onCollisionWithEveryBlock(other: EveryBlock) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        bounceOff(other)
        other.isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(other)
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val speed = 200f
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * speed
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                                                        println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }
                                                    if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(-45f, 120f)
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 360f + 0f), (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 200f + 100f))
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(score, everyManagerManager.score)
                                                    color = Color(0xFFE05050).copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    color = when (KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(3)) { 0 -> Color(0xFF20C060); 1 -> Color(0xFFFFFFFF); else -> Color(0xFF000000) }.copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    opacity = (0f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 60f + 20f) / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + -10f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + everyManagerManager.score / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
                                                    velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
                                                    // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
                                                    isRemoved = true
                                                    actorManager.remove(this)
                                                    bounceOff(other)
                                                    other.isRemoved = true
                                                    actorManager.remove(other)
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                                                        println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        val speed = velocity.x
                                                        if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                                    }
                                                    score = -1f
                                                    score += 0.5f
                                                    title = "Game \"over\""
                                                    isShielded = false
                                                    // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                    // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                                                        println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.

                                                    run {

                                                                nearest = candidate

                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                        if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * speed
                                                    }
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250

                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000

    protected open fun onTimer1Finished(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }

        }

            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }

                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(-45f, 120f)
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 360f + 0f), (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 200f + 100f))
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(score, everyManagerManager.score)
                                                    color = Color(0xFFE05050).copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    color = when (KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(3)) { 0 -> Color(0xFF20C060); 1 -> Color(0xFFFFFFFF); else -> Color(0xFF000000) }.copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    opacity = (0f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 60f + 20f) / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + -10f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + everyManagerManager.score / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val speed = 200f
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * speed
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                                                        println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }
                                                    if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(-45f, 120f)
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 360f + 0f), (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 200f + 100f))
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(score, everyManagerManager.score)
                                                    color = Color(0xFFE05050).copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    color = when (KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(3)) { 0 -> Color(0xFF20C060); 1 -> Color(0xFFFFFFFF); else -> Color(0xFF000000) }.copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    opacity = (0f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 60f + 20f) / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + -10f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + everyManagerManager.score / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    protected open fun onSpawnEnemyFinished(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
            println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val speed = 200f
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue

                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw

        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000

                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryParent")
                                                        println("[EveryParent] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))

                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size

                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")

                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(-45f, 120f)
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 360f + 0f), (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 200f + 100f))
                                                    velocity = velocityInDirection(score, everyManagerManager.score)
                                                    color = Color(0xFFE05050).copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    color = when (KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(3)) { 0 -> Color(0xFF20C060); 1 -> Color(0xFFFFFFFF); else -> Color(0xFF000000) }.copy(alpha = color.alpha)
                                                    opacity = (0f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 60f + 20f) / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + -10f / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                    opacity = (opacity + everyManagerManager.score / 100f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Turns the velocity away from [other], on the axis they overlap less on.
     */
    protected fun bounceOff(other: Visible) {
        val offset = body.position - other.body.position
        if (offset.x.raw.absoluteValue * (body.size.height + other.body.size.height).raw >= offset.y.raw.absoluteValue * (body.size.width + other.body.size.width).raw) {
            velocity = SceneOffset(if (offset.x > SceneUnit.Zero) velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit else -velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit, velocity.y)
        } else {
            velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x, if (offset.y > SceneUnit.Zero) velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit else -velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit)
        }
    }

    /**
     * The velocity of [speed] towards [directionInDegrees], clockwise from the right (a degree is 0.017453292 radians).
     */
    protected fun velocityInDirection(directionInDegrees: Float, speed: Float): SceneOffset {
        val radians = directionInDegrees * 0.017453292f
        return SceneOffset((cos(radians) * speed).sceneUnit, (sin(radians) * speed).sceneUnit)
    }

    protected fun Float.asText() = if (this % 1f == 0f) toLong().toString() else toString()
}

class EveryParent private constructor(state: State) : EveryParentBase(
    body = state.body,
    color = state.color,
    score = state.score,
    title = state.title,
    isShielded = state.isShielded,
    collisionMask = CircleCollisionMask(initialPosition = state.body.axisAlignedBoundingBox.let { (it.min + it.max) / 2 }, initialRadius = state.body.size.width * state.body.scale.horizontal / 2),
), Editable<EveryParent> {

    /**
     * Its shape in its color, at its opacity.
     */
    override val look = EllipseLook(color)
        get() {
            field.color = if (opacity < 1f) color.copy(alpha = color.alpha * opacity) else color
            return field
        }

    override fun save() = State(
        body = body,
        color = color,
        score = score,
        title = title,
        isShielded = isShielded,
    )

    @kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
    data class State(
        @SerialName("body") val body: SerializableBoxBody = BoxBody(),
        @SerialName("color") val color: SerializableColor = Color(0xFF6060AA),
        @SerialName("score") val score: Float = 2.5f,
        @SerialName("title") val title: String = "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone",
        @SerialName("isShielded") val isShielded: Boolean = true,
    ) : Serializable.State<EveryParent> {

        override fun restore() = EveryParent(this)

        override fun serialize() = Json.encodeToString(this)
    }

    companion object {
        val metadata = EditableMetadata.create<EveryParent, State>(typeId = "EveryParent") { position ->
            State(body = BoxBody(initialPosition = position, initialSize = SceneSize(80f.sceneUnit, 80f.sceneUnit)))
        }
    }
}
